key_insight: Generalized Feynman-Kac correctors enable sampling from arbitrary target functions of multiple pretrained diffusion models, correcting errors from naive score combinations.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports model composition and reward-based steering during generation without retraining or fine-tuning.
method: Derive a Feynman-Kac PDE and closed-form potential for geometric interpolation from an initial function to the target.
Generalize the log-probability ODE to track each model’s density along trajectories driven by a different velocity field.
Apply generation-time corrections entirely in the log domain, optionally incorporating downstream rewards.
evidence_signal: Tests on analytic Gaussian models closely matched ground-truth targets, while MNIST experiments demonstrated non-trivial model combinations and effective steering.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to Gaussian and MNIST settings; computational cost and scalability to larger diffusion models remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
